summary: Australian stages are set for a vibrant 2026 season, with Perth Festival unveiling an explosive program that blends local theatre icons with international dance exclusives. The festival highlights the transformative solo work 'Songs of the Bulbul' by UK choreographer Aakash Odedra, alongside local favourites like The Last Great Hunt. This season underscores a national commitment to diverse performance forms, from drama to high-concept dance, ensuring that Australian audiences have access to world-class artistic experiences.
